message: Read-only review of AutomationLivenessSupervisor.fs found two concrete Phase B gaps to address before qualification. (1) Claimed review handoffs can stall forever: reviewerStalled only checks statuses SuspectedStalled/StaleReadyLaunch/OrphanedJob/TerminalJobPendingReconciliation. In current Jarvis, a reviewer can own a claimed review while its agent state is NeedsWork (we have Reviewer7/9 in exactly that state), with no active session/job; this path reports StalledReviewer=false and 'Keep the claimed reviewer as owner; do not duplicate.' Include pending-review ownership plus active-session/last-seen age in the classification, preserving live-job/lease protection and never duplicating a live reviewer; add a regression for stale claimed reviewer in NeedsWork. (2) Operator escalation dedup is process-local (`reportedOperatorKeys`/`summaries`) and the update `Set.union (Set.difference reportedOperatorKeys activeKeys) activeKeys` never removes resolved keys. A restart re-emits every unresolved Operator challenge, contrary to 'escalate once'. Persist stable challenge/condition/version acknowledgement or use an existing durable idempotent notification mechanism; prune resolved keys and test restart + resolution/reappearance. Also the current sweep counts agent-owned challenge waits but does not yet dispatch/reassign them, as required by the spec. Please add focused tests; no Scheduler/Work Queue activation.
